source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43120) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Open and close the Sort drawer, then apply a filter from the drawer with an autofocus field, all with the keyboard
journey.goal: Opening the drawer moves focus into it, so the user can tick a filter and show results without a pointer

functionalJourney.title: Apply a filter with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking Filters, ticking Waterproof and clicking Show results applies the filter

guards.title: Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to Filters
guards.goal: After opening the drawer with the pointer, Escape closes it and focus is back on the Filters button

plan.root_cause: The drawer component does not move focus to an interactive element when opened via the toggle button, causing keyboard users to lose focus and requiring extra tab navigation to reach controls.
plan.repair_strategy: Override the _show method in Drawer to call super._show then move focus to the close button (data-bs-dismiss="drawer") or the drawer itself as fallback, ensuring keyboard users land inside the drawer immediately after opening.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When opening the Sort or Filters drawer with Enter or Space, focus will move to the close button inside the drawer, allowing immediate interaction with filter controls without additional tab presses.
functional_risks: If the drawer lacks a close button, focus will be set to the drawer element itself, which is inert but still allows tab navigation to internal focusable elements.
Potential focus conflict if the drawer already contains an element with autofocus attribute; however the close button precedes it in DOM.
No impact on mouse interactions or programmatic usage.
verification_requirements: Opening the Sort drawer via Enter on #sort-open results in focus on #sort-close.
Opening the Filters drawer via Enter on #filters-open results in focus on #filters-close (or the search input if autofocus present).
Escape key closes the drawer and returns focus to the toggle button.
Mouse click on toggle still opens drawer and does not disrupt focus.
Programmatic show() via Drawer.getOrCreateInstance(...).show() also focuses appropriately.

plan.root_cause: The drawer component relies on native <dialog> focus behavior when shown via showModal(). The native implementation focuses the first focusable element in the dialog (the close button) and does not honor the autofocus attribute on the search input. This causes keyboard users to land on the close button instead of the intended autofocus element when opening the Filters drawer.
plan.repair_strategy: Override the _show method in Drawer to call super._show() (which handles the native show and transition) and then explicitly move focus to the element with autofocus if present, otherwise to the close button (data-bs-dismiss="drawer"), with the drawer element itself as a final fallback. This ensures keyboard users land on the correct interactive element immediately after the drawer opens.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When opening the Filters drawer via Enter on #filters-open, focus will move to the search input (#filters-search) because it has the autofocus attribute. When opening the Sort drawer (which lacks autofocus), focus will move to the close button (#sort-close). In both cases, pressing Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to the respective toggle button. This allows keyboard users to immediately interact with filter controls without extra tab navigation.
functional_risks: If the autofocus element is not focusable (e.g., disabled), focus will fall back to the close button or drawer.

The focus adjustment occurs after the exit transition, which may cause a brief focus on the close button before moving to the autofocus element. This is visually negligible and does not affect functionality.
No impact on mouse interactions or programmatic usage of the drawer.
verification_requirements: Opening the Sort drawer via Enter on #sort-open results in focus on #sort-close.
Opening the Filters drawer via Enter on #filters-open results in focus on #filters-search (autofocus element).
Pressing Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to the toggle button (#sort-open or #filters-open).
Mouse click on toggle still opens drawer and does not disrupt focus.
Programmatic show() via Drawer.getOrCreateInstance(...).show() also focuses appropriately.
